slope_decomposition_gap.note: exact identity of least squares: ln(C_cat) = ln(C_feed) + ln(U) + const + ln(W/U), so the slopes add

eq5_numeric_fit_residual.note: find_roots xtol 1e-12 on V of order 30 to 80, so ln V is exact to about 1e-13; the chain is an exact power law

eq5_route_gap_max.note: the symbolic and the root-found routes share the isolation of V and differ in solver only; set by find_roots xtol 1e-12

eq5_misreadings_total.note: the number of misreadings tried, by construction of the list

eq5_last_digit_alternatives_total.note: five inputs times two directions, by construction of the sweep

doubling_decomposition_gap.note: the same additivity of least-squares slopes, against temperature

K_over_A2_required.note: the exact symbolic result of integrating dC/dtheta = K/C from a clean catalyst, 1/2 whatever number is printed; its numeric twin K_printed_numeric_overshoot carries the break rows

K_half_numeric_gap.note: solve_ivp rtol 1e-10 on the integration with K = A^2 / 2

K_numeric_tolerance_shift.note: change of either ODE ratio when rtol 1e-10 is tightened to 1e-12
